name: SLIPPERY_ICE_GRIT_YELLOW_LONG

w5-20_slippery_car.desc: AS 1743 W5-20 skidding car (national symbol reused; sheet: 'for details of slippery sign refer AS 1742-(W5-20)')

notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet 3403-3/P94 'Symbolic slippery ice/grit temporary warning sign T1-105 (Spec. R100 type 5)' (2007), 1800 x 900, black on Class 1 yellow, 'border to be 20mm black with 10mm outer yellow'; corner radius not stated (measured about 60). Left panel 870 wide (sheet) with the W5-20 car symbol, divider drawn as a 20 black bar at 870 joining the border; symbol box = the sheet's ink extent (106-835 x 142-821). ICE/ over GRIT, '160DN' (Series D) black, centred in the right panel (cx 1320), cap tops 221 / 523 from the measured line centres 301 / 603 (the sheet's letters measure about 180 high and Series-E-wide: the letter note is followed).
